description: Find every 8-K filing in the last N days that declared a specific SEC Item code. Use for cross-market scans like "show me every restatement (Item 4.02) this month" or "every cybersecurity incident (Item 1.05) this quarter". Common items: 1.01 (material agreement), 1.05 (cyber incident), 2.01 (M&A close), 2.02 (earnings), 4.02 (restatement), 5.01 (change of control), 5.02 (officer departure), 7.01 (Reg FD).

days.description: Look-back window in days. Default 7, max 60.

item.description: SEC Item code like "4.02" or "5.02". Exact match.

name: sec_8k_by_item
title: Sec 8k By Item
